ns2:course.label: Tax Research
ns2:course.description: Provides the student with a working knowledge of tax research methodology utilized by accountants in public practice. Aims to develop the student's capacity for either solving or defending his/her position with respect to a particular tax issue. May be repeated with consent of the department. Prerequisite: Graduate standing or consent of department.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated with consent of the department. Prerequisite: Graduate standing or consent of department.
